# Follow-up: Architecture review: idempotent retries
2026-10-16

## What we decided
- Adopt idempotent retries using a client-sent dedupe key (Option A); do not build a server-side dedupe table.. Why: Option B would incorrectly block two legitimate payments of the same amount within the window; the gateway already supports an idempotency key header so only clients need to change.
- Jun will write the ADR for the idempotent-retry decision by Wednesday.
- Theo will update the reconciliation job to read the dedupe key.
- Rollout order: web client first, then the mobile client in the release after next; Mira owns the rollout plan.
- The speaker will write a stakeholder update informing the support team that duplicate charges will stop after the mobile release.

results.body_markdown:
**Team adopts client-side idempotency keys (Option A) for payment retries; server dedupe table dropped**

**Highlights**
- Decision reached: adopt client dedupe key (idempotency key header) for all payment requests; gateway already supports it, so no gateway changes needed
- Consensus confirmed by Mira and Theo; server-side dedupe table (Option B) explicitly rejected due to false-positive risk on same-amount payments
- Rollout sequence agreed: web client first, then mobile client in the release after next

**Risks**
- All four clients must be updated to send the dedupe key; mobile client ships on a two-week cadence, delaying full coverage
- Duplicate charges remain possible until the mobile release ships; support team must be briefed in the interim

**Next steps**
- Jun to write the ADR for Option A by Wednesday
- Mira to own and publish the rollout plan (web → mobile)
- Theo to update the reconciliation job to read the idempotency key
- Speaker to draft stakeholder/support-team update noting duplicate charges will cease after the mobile release
